name: wait_for
description: Wait for the specified text to appear on the selected page. By default, hidden text is also matched. Set visible to true to wait until the matched text is visible.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

text.description: Non-empty list of texts. Resolves when any value appears on the page.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

visible.description: If true, wait until the matching text is visible. By default, hidden text also counts.
